BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 30, 2026, it repurchased 78,999 of its ordinary shares across various trading venues, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $101.7189. These repurchases are part of a share buyback program of up to $300 million, which is scheduled to conclude by April 28, 2026. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH plc will have 668,383,773 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.063% of the issued share capital. Disclaimer* 31 st March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 30 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 668,383,773 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,643,874 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.063% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
